applicability: Bound role-agent activity from the installed host publisher to the dashboard host input.
conditions: Only recorded AR role agents contribute; lifecycle events update one replaceable publication.
A new dashboard input and a newly observed host boot each require complete bridge reconciliation; failed reconciliation stays unknown and retries only on a new publication generation.
Idle heartbeat, periodic full-heal and degraded wakes retain admitted host input instead of polling activity.
exclusions: No global once-ever host read across dashboard restarts.
Supervisor lease liveness is not task activity; this records source-defined guards, not a fresh Curator host witness.
